response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_averages AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(account_average) AS frequency_average FROM account_averages) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.frequency, aa.account_average, aa.account_average / NULLIF(fa.frequency_average, 0) AS ratio FROM account_averages AS aa JOIN frequency_averages AS fa ON fa.frequency = aa.frequency ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
